message: 夕暮れの横顔

name: Paqy
message: 「Hehehe... Just as expected of you, Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「You've got the wrong idea」

name: Paqy
message: 「Using Student Council activities as an excuse to scout out peeping spots and spy on the school's girls--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm just documenting the current state of the planned setup area before we start setting up. Especially the layout of the trees」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'd appreciate an explanation before the chop」

name: Synn
message: 「You bounce back fast」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's the big deal? Don't be so stingy over a tree or two. You'll never become a great Demon Lord acting like that」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not how it works. Nature is important, and besides, it'd cost money if we ended up cutting them down」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hehehe... Just as expected, Demon Lord. Funneling those saved expenses into the wealth of your totalitarian state--」

name: Synn
message: 「You've got the wrong idea about that too」

name: Paqy
message: 「So your scheme is to doctor the photos you took, use 'em as proof later to make up a bunch of lies, and extort money out of 'em」

name: Synn
message: 「It's just taking precautions beforehand」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's the mysterious transfer student」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder what he's looking at?」
Azel was sitting on the courtyard lawn, intently gazing at something resting on his lap.
I quietly approached and peeked over his shoulder from behind.
Azel spun around as if startled by a jolt.
Spread open on his lap was the mountain photo book, "Fleeting Moments of the Mountains."

name: Synn
message: 「So you borrowed that photo book」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I did no such thing as borrow it」

name: Synn
message: 「Then... did you take it without permission?」

name: Azel
message: 「D-Don't say things that give the wrong impression. T-This is, well...」

name: Azel
message: 「It just happened to be in my hands」

name: Synn
message: 「You borrowed it, didn't you?」

name: Azel
message: 「Books are pointless. I didn't borrow it. It was lying on the ground」

name: Synn
message: 「You were totally engrossed in reading it, though」

name: Azel
message: 「You're mistaken」
Azel closed the book and set it curtly beside himself, feigning indifference. Man, he's stubborn.

name: Synn
message: 「Then we have to return it to the library」
With a slight touch of mischief, when I reached out for the book.

name: Azel
message: 「What are you doing!」
Azel swiftly clutched the book to himself.

name: Synn
message: 「Well... you're not going to read it, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「T-That's... true」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I'll go return it for you」

name: Azel
message: 「There's no need to do it right this second」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be scary if Melilot-san thinks you took it out without permission」

name: Azel
message: 「Scary?」

name: Synn
message: 「For some reason, she apparently knows the exact location of every single book in the library's collection」

name: Synn
message: 「If you have an overdue book or took one without checking it out, she suddenly appears every break period and politely tells you to return it」

name: Synn
message: 「Apparently, there was even a student whose hair turned pure white the day after being made to return a book」

name: Synn
message: 「If you're scared of Melilot-san, I'll go return it for you, though」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I am not scared in the slightest」
So he is scared.

name: Azel
message: 「Besides... that's impossible」

name: Synn
message: 「What is?」

name: Azel
message: 「There's no way she's keeping track of that huge number」

name: Azel
message: 「What's with that look, like you're staring at someone who doesn't know anything」

name: Synn
message: 「...I didn't think it was possible either, and I thought it was just a rumor, though」
That was...

name: Azel
message: 「...What on earth happened?」
That was terrifying...

name: Azel
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry... I can't remember... I feel like something unimaginably terrifying happened, but... when I try to remember, I get the shakes and a headache...」

name: Synn
message: 「Even being overdue is that terrifying, so if she thinks it was taken without permission, what kind of hell would she put us through...」

name: Azel
message: 「What kind?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nobody's had a death wish like that for the past ten years, so I don't know... b-but」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph」

name: Azel
message: 「I followed the proper procedures to borrow it, so there's no need to be afraid」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh. So you did borrow it after all」

name: Synn
message: 「She is pretty, after all」

name: Azel
message: 「...It was just a whim」

name: Synn
message: 「Even you act on a whim sometimes, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「...Shut up」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah」
Now then, guess I'll get back to work.
At this rate, Azel won't be able to read the photo book either.

name: Azel
message: 「What is that」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, this. It's a digicam」

name: Azel
message: 「What is a digicam?」

name: Synn
message: 「A camera. A digital camera」

name: Azel
message: 「Camera?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait... do you not know what a camera is?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I know. A camera, yes, a camera」
Just what kind of country is Azel from...

name: Synn
message: 「I know you know, but just in case. A camera is a machine for taking photos」

name: Azel
message: 「Taking photos?」
I knew it. Azel doesn't even know what a photo is.
I operated the digicam in front of Azel to show him.

name: Synn
message: 「You point this part at the scene you want to capture. And then, when you press this button」
Then I loaded the image I had just taken from the memory.

name: Synn
message: 「The scene from just now is recorded, see?」

name: Azel
message: 「Ooh」

name: Synn
message: 「The scenes in that photobook were also taken with a camera, though the operating principle is different from this one」
Azel stared intently at the cover of the photobook.

name: Azel
message: 「...S-So it's what creates things like this」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right」

name: Synn
message: 「Though, I'm not a professional photographer, so I can't take pretty photos like those」

name: Azel
message: 「Photographer?」

name: Synn
message: 「People who make a living taking photos like these that move people's hearts」

name: Azel
message: 「...Unbelievable」
Perhaps suddenly noticing my gaze, Azel turned away.

name: Azel
message: 「W-What a pointless existence」
He doesn't have to force himself to say things like that.

name: Azel
message: 「You don't need them to live. They're pointless.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, if you put it like that, most things are.」

name: Azel
message: 「Ridiculous. Nothing but a waste.」

name: Synn
message: 「They're pretty, though.」

name: Azel
message: 「Indeed.」

name: Azel
message: 「I am not impressed!」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm not.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah, yeah.」

name: Azel
message: 「I have no interest in them either.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gotcha.」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't.」

name: Synn
message: 「I know, I know.」
Holding back a smile, I stepped away from Azel.
Back to work. I'd like to get the data sorted out today if I can.
Yeah. Going smoothly.
At this rate, I should be able to get back to the Student Council room before it's time to leave school, transfer the data to the computer, and organize it.
I glanced over at Azel.
Completely absorbed. Guess he really likes it after all.
Photos were a bit of a surprise, though.
Oh, looks like he finished looking through it.
He's starting over from the beginning again.
Oops. If I stare too much, he'll notice. Come on, work, work.
Almost done taking pictures...

name: Azel
message: 「What are you doing?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa.」
Before I knew it, Azel was standing right next to me.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, it's you, Azel... You scared me.」

name: Azel
message: 「What is that」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, this. It's a digicam」

name: Azel
message: 「A digicam?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... a camera. It's a digital camera.」

name: Azel
message: 「Camera?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait... do you not know what a camera is?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I know. A camera, yes, a camera」
Not even having cameras--just what kind of place is Azel's homeland?

name: Synn
message: 「Um... I'm sure you know this, but a camera is a machine for taking photos.」

name: Azel
message: 「Photos?」
You don't even know what photos are, huh.

name: Azel
message: 「O-Of course I know. Photos, yes, photos.」
I operated the digicam in front of Azel to show him.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure you know this too, but... you point this part at the scenery you want to capture. And then, when you press this button--」
Then I loaded the image I had just taken from the memory.

name: Synn
message: 「The scene from just now is recorded, see?」
Azel stood stunned for a while.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「To think you possessed such a transcendent skill!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm just an amateur.」

name: Azel
message: 「Yet you can create something of this caliber.」

name: Synn
message: 「...There are plenty of much more amazing photos out there, though.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Is that true?」

name: Synn
message: 「Want to go see them?」

name: Azel
message: 「I have no interest.」
Then why are you following me?
I'd come to understand Azel well enough not to say that out loud.

name: Synn
message: 「Keep quiet in the library, okay? There's someone scary here.」

name: Azel
message: 「I am not scared.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Who might you be calling scary?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」
Turning around, I saw Melilot-san standing there.
She's the librarian, a figure steeped in countless legends.

name: Melilot
message: 「Synn Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Were you not the Student Council President?」

name: Synn
message: 「I am, but...」

name: Melilot
message: 「With the Charity Bazaar just around the corner, the Student Council ought to be busy. Why, then, are you here?」
Cold sweat trickled down my back. Somehow, I had a really bad feeling about this.

name: Helena
message: 「Now, now, Melilot. Let's keep things peaceful here, okay?」

name: Melilot
message: 「And you say that as the chairwoman? That sets a terrible example.」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan just showed that girl the way here.」
Melilot-san turned toward Azel.

name: Melilot
message: 「So this is the rumored transfer student?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right. Azel-chan.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Pleased to meet you. I am Melilot, and I have the honor of serving as the librarian at Ryuusei Academy.」
Melilot-san gave a polite bow, however.
Azel was looking the other way.

name: Helena
message: 「Hehe. Acting all aloof like that is pretty cute too, isn't it? Like a complicated maiden's heart in adolescence.」

name: Azel
message: 「Not true.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Pleased to meet you, I am Melilot, and I have the honor of serving as the librarian at Ryuusei Academy.」
Azel tried to walk away, looking annoyed, but

name: Azel
message: 「What are you doing!」
Melilot-san's arm shot out gracefully and swiftly, her slender fingers grabbing Azel's shoulder.

name: Melilot
message: 「Pleased to meet you, I am Melilot, and I have the honor of serving as the librarian at Ryuusei Academy.」

name: Azel
message: 「Let go!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Quiet in the library, please.」
She was still smiling... S-scary.
For a split second, Azel shot me a look pleading for help...
And immediately looked away.

name: Melilot
message: 「Manners and etiquette are important, after all.」
She had a point. I glanced over at Helena-san.
She looked like she was enjoying this.

name: Melilot
message: 「Pleased to meet you, I am Melilot, and I have the honor of serving as the librarian at Ryuusei Academy.」
Azel didn't greet Melilot-san properly last time either, after all.
That's probably why she got singled out today. Saying 'Pleased to meet you' even though it wasn't their first time.
Azel tried resisting in silence for a good while, until finally.

name: Azel
message: 「...Azel.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel-san, is it? I have committed it firmly to memory. Now, right this way.」

name: Azel
message: 「L-let go!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Quiet, please」
Without letting go of Azel, Melilot marched him over to the checkout counter.

name: Melilot
message: 「Do you know the checkout procedure?」

name: Azel
message: 「I won't use it」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems you do not. Then I shall teach you」

name: Azel
message: 「No need」

name: Melilot
message: 「Whether you need it or not is irrelevant. Anyone who might possibly use the library will learn it」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel... don't be so stubborn, just learn it for now」

name: Helena
message: 「If in the east there is one making noise in the library, she appears from nowhere, gently, yet endlessly lecturing until they quiet down,」

name: Synn
message: 「What's with you all of a sudden?」

name: Helena
message: 「If in the west there is one who knows not how to check out books, she appears from nowhere, thoroughly and politely explaining until they learn,」

name: Helena
message: 「If in the south there is an insolent soul with an overdue book, she appears from nowhere, demanding its return,」

name: Helena
message: 「If in the north there is a fool who takes a book without permission, she appears from nowhere, inflicting a punishment that remains as eternal trauma...」

name: Helena
message: 「I wouldn't go against such a super-competent librarian if I were you」

name: Melilot
message: 「I don't know who you're referring to, but I wouldn't go against someone like that either」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, right, I just had a great idea\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「I happen to have a book right here that I came to return, so borrow this」
Saying so, Helena placed a book on the counter.
It was a photo book of the Alps titled "Fleeting Moments of the Mountains."

name: Melilot
message: 「Didn't you just borrow this yesterday? Was it not to your liking?」

name: Helena
message: 「No, that's not it. I was so moved by it that I was like, 'I want it, I want it, I want it, I want it,' and ordered it online」

name: Helena
message: 「So I really want other people to read it too」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you enjoyed it that much, it was worth recommending」

name: Helena
message: 「Seriously. Your book recommendations never miss」

name: Melilot
message: 「I've been doing this a long time, after all」

name: Azel
message: 「...I refuse」

name: Helena
message: 「No way. It's the chairwoman's orders. If you don't borrow it, you'll be in big trouble\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. Rather than just memorizing the steps, it's actually easier to remember the procedure if you borrow something」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, this is the one I was talking about earlier. The one with photos even more amazing than the ones I took. Look」
I opened the photo book so Azel could see it.
Peaks covered in pure white snow leapt into view.

name: Synn
message: 「Well?」
Azel turned away with a huff.

name: Azel
message: 「...Not interested」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, just take a look for now」

name: Azel
message: 「Not interested」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then would you like to switch to a different book?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm not borrowing anything」

name: Melilot
message: 「Would you like to switch to a different book?」

name: Azel
message: 「...This one is fine」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then, using 'Fleeting Moments of the Mountains' as an example, I will explain this library's lending procedure」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. That is correct」

name: Melilot
message: 「That concludes the lecture on this library's lending procedure. Thank you for your attention」
Melilot-san's fingers left Azel's shoulder.
That's definitely going to leave a mark... It did on me, too.
As if he had been waiting for this moment, Azel swiftly picked up the photo book and clutched it to his chest.

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my~. Azel-chan, do you really want to read that so badly? You've been stealing glances at it the whole time」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's not really like that」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right. Azel doesn't have the slightest interest in something like this, after all」

name: Azel
message: 「R-Right. I have no interest whatsoever」
He's really forcing himself.

name: Helena
message: 「What, not interested? How boring~」

name: Helena
message: 「Over in that section of the library, they've got tons of photo books like that, you know.」

name: Azel
message: 「Ah!」
Azel looked toward the photo book corner Helena-san was pointing at, his eyes sparkling for a brief moment, before quickly looking away.

name: Azel
message: 「...I have no interest.」

name: Helena
message: 「My, how cold.」

name: Melilot
message: 「As far as this library is concerned, as long as books are returned by the due date without damage, that is all that matters.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Whether or not you actually read the contents is of no concern to me.」

name: Helena
message: 「What a lie. Even though you love books so much.」
Melilot-san cleared her throat once.

name: Melilot
message: 「Ahem... However, speaking personally, I do hope that the encounter between the borrower and the borrowed book becomes something wonderful and irreplaceable.」
Clutching the photo book to his chest, Azel was looking around restlessly.

name: Synn
message: 「At this hour, there shouldn't be anyone in that courtyard from earlier.」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that so!」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's not like I want to read it as soon as possible or anything!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah」
Returning to the courtyard from earlier, I resumed my work.
Yeah. Going smoothly.
At this rate, I should be able to get back to the Student Council room before it's time to leave school, transfer the data to the computer, and organize it.
I glanced over at Azel.
He's completely absorbed. Maybe he actually liked it?
Even earlier, when he saw the cover, he looked deeply impressed, so that's probably it.
A photo book was a bit unexpected, though.
He's really staring at it intently...
Oh, looks like he finished reading it.
Hugging the photo book to his chest with such a happy look on his face...
It must have really moved him.

name: Azel
message: 「Haaah...」
He's kinda cute...

name: Azel
message: 「I-I'm not moved at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Oops, back to work, back to work.」

name: Azel
message: 「I said I'm not!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah, I know.」

name: Synn
message: 「...I guess that's about good.」
It's starting to get a little cold, so maybe I should call it a day.
I took quite a lot, but... how many photos did I end up taking?
Whoa. There's only enough memory left for two more shots. Just barely made it.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. It's getting cold, so maybe we should head back soon--」
I called out, or at least I tried to.
My voice didn't seem to reach Azel, who was completely absorbed in the scenery inside the photo book.
Bathed in the setting sun, that short hair shone like bundles of golden straw.
Specks of light sparkled on the eyelashes framing those slightly upturned eyes.
Those lips, usually pressed tightly shut, were parted just a fraction as if in sheer awe, looking soft.
Two shots left. It feels like a waste not to take them, doesn't it?
I quietly crept closer.
I had a feeling that if I got noticed, the Azel right in front of me would vanish.
Even when I walked right up close, Azel still didn't notice.
Holding my breath, I readied my digital camera, and--

name: Azel
message: 「Wh-Wha?!」
Azel looked up with a start.
That face was terribly flustered and completely defenseless.
It was cute.

name: Azel
message: 「W-What did you just do!」

name: Synn
message: 「...I took a picture of your face, Azel.」
A bewildered expression asking, "Why?"
Why, indeed?

name: Synn
message: 「Um... I just wanted to take it.」

name: Azel
message: 「Wanted to take it?」
I nodded.

name: Azel
message: 「...Your actions make no sense to me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... How should I put it? I wanted to preserve the look on your face just now.」

name: Azel
message: 「Preserve it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I wanted to keep it forever.」
So that I can remember the feelings and the atmosphere of this moment.

name: Azel
message: 「Forever...?」
Having Azel stare at me like that felt ticklish, so I looked away.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, even if I say forever, it's only as long as the data and printouts don't disappear, so maybe around a hundred years?」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, at the very least, it'll be fine for as long as I'm alive」
Ugh, what am I even saying. I sound like an idiot.
Azel abruptly stood up and turned his back to me.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「Nothing will remain」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's pointless」

name: Synn
message: 「...Did I upset you because I took the picture so suddenly?」
Without saying a word, Azel walked briskly away.
A cold wind blew past my feet.
